title: Fanny Backhurst
dates: (fl.15 March 1852)
---

a pupil of CMY at Otterbourne school

She married a soldier and just died three weeks after the birth of her baby.

She was probably daughter of James Backhurst (b. 1800/1), carpenter, of Otterbourne.
